plans.goal: Give the macOS app a deterministic SwiftUI frame-health lane, use it to baseline and rank the UI's real costs, land the maintainer-approved safe fixes, and stage a brand-preserving refresh gated on the maintainer's remote review of the proposals artifact.

plans.goal: Fix the maintainer-reported download crawl (Hugging Face's CDN shapes throughput per connection, so single-stream multi-gigabyte files always decay) with chunked parallel byte-range transfers, gated by the model-delivery tuning policy's controlled-comparison requirement; extend to iOS only after the background-session identity work and a device A/B.

Instrument-first ordering is mandatory - the 2026-06 iOS fix wave shipped unmeasured and its own commit messages say so. Pre-arc housekeeping (standalone commit): add the missing ui-ios-delivery-cohort workflow to config/orchestration-contract.json (existing lane unrunnable without it).

items.title: Medium — make behavior-changing diagnostics an enforceable distribution boundary
items.gate: Classify registered knobs as observability-only or behavior/policy mutation. Make distributed builds unable to disable publication marking or redirect other policy-sensitive behavior through process environment alone, using an internal-build capability or an explicitly documented product policy. Preserve bounded diagnostics and record provenance whenever an internal diagnostic build mutates output.
items.notes: Closed 2026-08-26. The runtime registry is schema v2 and classifies every key as behavior/policy mutation, bounded observability, or the capability gate. Behavior-changing RuntimeDebugGate reads now require both the repository-owned VOCELLO_INTERNAL_DIAGNOSTICS compile capability and QWENVOICE_DEBUG; local build, deterministic-test, UI-test, and device-diagnostics routes opt in explicitly, while macOS and iOS distribution routes are contractually forbidden from carrying the capability. QWENVOICE_MARKING=off therefore cannot disable Article 50 publication marking in a distributed binary even when its process environment is controlled. Bounded observability has a separate reader and remains available without product-policy mutation. Generation telemetry records the active override key names and a digest of their exact values, never the values themselves. Swift regression tests prove the distributed and internal branches, Python fixtures prove route leakage/missing-capability failures, runtime security passes, and the complete macOS deterministic suite passed outside the sandbox.

Ordinary macOS CI therefore executes the assertions without a phone, while generic/platform=iOS still proves the same source against the physical-device SDK and Xcode 26's unsupported tool-hosted device execution is not misrepresented. The host suite passed all 437 tests including 19/19 VocelloiOSLogicTests, and the iOS app plus standalone policy bundle both compiled successfully outside the managed sandbox. Physical-device runtime and UI acceptance remain unchanged and XCUITest-only.

items.title: Medium — durably couple audio publication and History persistence
items.gate: Add a durable pending-history outbox/sidecar after atomic WAV publication, clear it only after the database commit, reconcile it at startup and History open, and expose privacy-safe retry/reveal/export state. Make clear-all resumable or database-first so a database failure cannot leave live rows pointing to already-deleted files. Current schedulePersistence uses an unstructured detached task with no retry, and clearAll deletes files before deleting rows.
items.notes: Closed 2026-08-26. Every published take is atomically queued in a schema-v1 app-support outbox before its idempotent audioPath-bound SQLite write; startup and History entry reconcile pending work, and visible recovery offers retry plus platform-appropriate reveal/export. Interrupted entry and clear-marker writes recover fail closed. Clear-all now persists a resumable transaction, deletes database rows first, then removes outbox entries and requested audio, so database failure preserves live rows and files. Deterministic tests cover commit/removal ordering, database failure and replay, duplicate identity, corrupt/interrupted records, missing audio, clear resumption, and database-first deletion.

items.title: Medium — close the main-branch administrator and security-timing gap
items.gate: Preserve the maintainer-required main-only workflow while making its residual risk explicit and release-safe: either enforce required checks for administrators through a compatible protected-merge mechanism, or formally accept direct-main admin bypass for ordinary development and make exact-SHA green CI plus path-relevant security verdicts mandatory before release promotion. Add pull-request/path timing for CodeQL and npm advisory checks where compatible, and require signed release tags. Live GitHub state on 2026-08-19 still had enforce_admins=false and required_signatures=false; the direct main push of f6404ce reported a required-check bypass. Force-push and branch deletion are already disabled.
items.notes: Closed 2026-08-26 through the gate's compatible acceptance branch. Live read-only GitHub inspection confirmed strict CI required, force-push and deletion disabled, but enforce_admins=false, required_signatures=false, and no ruleset; that direct-main administrator bypass remains an explicit ordinary-development residual because main-only direct development is a maintainer requirement. Release and promotion now fail closed unless the release source is in origin/main, the version tag is annotated and GitHub-verified with reason=valid, and the exact commit's latest CI required and Security required check runs are completed successfully. Path routing brings CodeQL to native/website pull requests and npm advisory audit to website-relevant pushes and pull requests, while a stable Security required aggregate gives the release boundary an exact-SHA verdict. Supply-chain contracts and 41 focused tests cover missing, unsigned, cross-SHA, incomplete, failed, paginated, path-routing, and weakened-workflow cases. No live repository setting was mutated as part of this source change.

Focused native acceptance passed outside the managed sandbox: macos-xcui-localization-20260826-173053-a9e0d9d6 ran the pseudo-localized macOS readiness journey, and ios-xcui-localization-20260826-173528-7744c05b walked Settings and Voice Models at Default, AX-L, AX-XXXL, and Pseudo-AX-XXXL on the paired physical iPhone. items.gate: Add a per-target entitlement allowlist/diff gate for every deterministic change and release, retain negative loading tests, and re-evaluate allow-unsigned-executable-memory and disable-library-validation on each MLX upgrade. The weekly/manual macos-26 TSan workflow runs the 460-test deterministic core and 18-test injectable XPC transport subset, retains evidence for 14 days, never retries automatically, and remains non-blocking only through the bounded 2026-09-30 characterization window. items.title: Move 1: fix the found defects, harden the harness, run the calibration session
items.gate: Landed and scored 2026-08-04. The maintainer's 146-trial blind session (88 identification + 6 repeats + 12 clone rows + 40 2AFC; single listener, non-native English — positives read as solid, nulls as provisional): pooled identification 26/88 = 0.295 against a 0.125 chance floor (exact binomial p = 2e-05). The perceptible half of the roster matches the acoustic study's winners exactly — calm 0.55 and whisper 0.55 (p = .001), neutral 0.36 and sad 0.36 (p = .039) — while the high-arousal trio fails as identities: angry 0/11 (never named Angry, mostly Unsure), happy 0.18 (heard as Surprised), surprised 0.18 (Unsure); fearful 0.18 is heard as Sad (6/11), confirming F2's low-arousal rendering. 2AFC: session engaged (anchors 4/4); verdict no_measured_strong_tier_collapse — the attractor claim behind the intensity retirement does not replicate; angry-group discrimination 0.75 [0.551, 0.88] after one declared mis-keystroke correction on trial 141 (angry is distinguishable when named, though never identified unprompted — difference is not identity, listener-confirmed); angry-vs-happy (the canonical same-arousal opposite-valence pair) sits at chance at strong and 0.75 at normal, with the angry group's strong-minus-normal drop borderline at -0.33 [-0.61, 0.02]; control pairs are MORE discriminable at strong (+0.50 [0.001, 0.812]), supporting ship-strong perceptually. Clone-transfer rows: 2/12 overall — but the 2 hits are angry.clone at 0.667, the only route through which the listener ever heard anger (instruct angry: 0/11); happy/sad/whisper clones read neutral-ish because their single-shot design references never audibly carried the emotion — reference curation, not the ICL mechanism, is the gap. items.title: Move 2: curated design-then-clone emotion reference banks
items.gate: Landed 2026-08-04. scripts/build_emotion_reference_bank.py generates N VoiceDesign candidates per emotion against a neutral anchor, scores them (pinned SER advisory + ECAPA identity-to-anchor + prosody deltas, strictly after generation per the 8 GB rule), selects the emotion-passing candidate nearest the anchor's identity (never peak expressiveness), and enrolls winners as ordinary saved voices — so every existing clone surface uses banks today with no engine changes. First real bank (Warm Narrator): SER-verified happy 0.74 / sad 0.72 / angry 0.48 references enrolled; whisper honestly refused (candidates measured MORE voiced than the anchor — VoiceDesign rendered soft-but-voiced speech, and the voiced-fraction criterion entangles pause structure; a breathiness HNR/CPP criterion is the recorded follow-up). End-to-end proof (12 clone takes, 3 seeds x 4 voices): identity 0.81-0.89 throughout; sad 3/3 and angry 3/3 SER-categorical — the session's uncurated sad clones read neutral 0/3, so curation demonstrably closes the instruct-to-reference gap — while happy's clones read angry despite the happy-verified reference (arousal survives the clone hop; valence did not, per an instrument that also shows an angry-bias on this voice's anchor takes — human audition owns the verdict). The silent x-vector fallback is disclosed on both platforms: macOS clone readiness gains a 'Ready — identity only' state and the iOS save-voice transcript caption states what the transcript unlocks. Follow-ups recorded: grouped persona/delivery picker UI, whisper breathiness criterion. Maintainer audition on the freshly launched build (2026-08-04, informal/sighted): the bank voices sound as intended, including Happy — the human verdict the proof run deferred to; the SER angry-reading on Happy clones stands as an instrument caveat only. First real use also found the clone readiness note saying 'Ready to generate' beside a Generate button disabled by the one-time cloning consent; the readiness descriptor is now consent-aware on both platforms so the status line and the button can never disagree again.

items.title: Whisper breathiness criterion for bank curation
items.gate: The first bank build (Warm Narrator, 2026-08-04) honestly refused whisper: VoiceDesign rendered soft-but-voiced speech, and the voiced-fraction criterion entangles pause structure (its denominator is the whole take). Replace it with a breathiness criterion from the bounded analyzer's voice-quality block (HNR/CPP deltas versus the anchor), validated on the existing scored candidates before any regeneration, so whisper can join a bank only when the phonation actually changed. Recorded follow-up in docs/reference/emotion-reference-banks.md. MEASURED 2026-08-04 (criterion prototype on the existing Warm Narrator candidates, analyze_prosody voice-quality block): the whisper candidates are MORE harmonic than the neutral anchor (delta-HNR +1.0..+1.4 dB, delta-CPP -0.5..+1.7 dB) while sad shows the most negative deltas of the whole bank — so the criterion axis works as an instrument, but these candidates contain no breathiness for any criterion to select: VoiceDesign rendered no whisper phonation at all, not merely too-voiced takes. Re-scoped accordingly: the remaining work is a whisper GENERATION recipe first (brief-wording variants, or cloning from a genuinely whispered reference), with the HNR/CPP-delta gate (breathier-than-anchor, e.g. deltaHNR <= -2 dB) wired into the builder as the acceptance criterion once candidates can plausibly pass it. GENERATION-RECIPE EXPLORATION PRE-REGISTERED 2026-08-04 (this commit precedes its generation). Mechanism note from the recovered Move 2 build: candidates used the persona brief plus the shipped whisper.strong INSTRUCTION only — the brief channel never asked for whisper. Design: anchor stays the existing Warm Narrator anchor_s42000.wav (persona brief 'A warm, calm middle-aged male narrator with a clear, measured pace.', digest-verified against the bank manifest); six registered variants, four fresh seeds each (seeds 20260850+10*variant+i): V1 control replicates the failed original (base brief + whisper.strong delivery); V2 brief-only 'base brief, speaking entirely in a hushed whisper.'; V3 brief-only 'base brief, whispering very quietly, breathy and unvoiced, as if not to wake someone.'; V4 brief-only 'base brief. His voice is a soft breathy whisper with no vocal cord tone.'; V5 = V2's brief plus whisper.strong delivery (both channels); V6 base brief plus the custom instruction 'Whisper the entire passage: fully breathy, unvoiced, air over the words, close to the microphone.'. All design/speed on the bank transcript. Criterion (as already re-scoped): a candidate is whispered when delta voice_hnr_db_mean versus the anchor is at most -2 dB; delta CPP and delta voiced fraction reported as secondary; ECAPA identity reported for passing candidates. Success rule: any variant with at least 2 of 4 candidates passing breathiness becomes the recipe wired into the bank builder (follow-up code change under this item); all-variants-fail closes the VoiceDesign route and leaves cloning a genuinely whispered human reference as the remaining path. RESULTS 2026-08-04 (run exactly as registered): ALL SIX VARIANTS FAIL — every surviving candidate across brief-only whisper identities (V2/V3/V4), both-channels (V5), the stronger custom instruction (V6), and the original-recipe control (V1) measured MORE harmonic than the anchor (delta HNR +0.06..+2.91 dB against the -2 dB pass bar; voiced fraction UP in 17 of 19 survivors). The registered all-fail rule closes the VoiceDesign route: this checkpoint's design channel renders 'whisper' as soft-but-fully-voiced speech regardless of where the request lives. Side-finding, recorded not hidden: 5 of 24 takes fell to the fast audio QC's dropout detector (1.4-1.9 s dropout codes) concentrated in whisper-adjacent generations — low-energy breathy audio can read as dropout to the gate, so any future whisper lane needs a whisper-aware QC posture before its takes can even survive to scoring. The bank builder keeps refusing whisper honestly; the one remaining path is cloning a genuinely whispered human reference (needs a recorded clip - maintainer-assisted), with the validated HNR/CPP criterion as its acceptance gate. Closed as measured.

items.title: Confirmatory delivery re-measure on solid statistics (audit R4)
items.gate: The audit's R4: regenerate one full delivery matrix on fresh seeds with the hardened harness (retained WAVs, prompt provenance, computed chance floors), score with delivery_separability.py in confirmatory designation (pre-registered), apply FDR correction and bootstrap CIs, add the happy-vs-angry 2-way probe, and run a parallel 8-bit Quality arm — the quantization-vs-adherence question has never been measured here. Runs unattended (generation plus analyzer scoring; no listening). Decision input for whether any directional hint can be promoted back to a distinct delivery. AMENDMENT 2026-08-04 (pre-data; no cell was ever scored): the sweep's first live run exposed a defect in Move 1's fail-closed provenance guard — notes.promptChars counts only the script text, which never includes the delivery instruction, so the instructed-longer-than-neutral premise could never pass live (it had only ever run against synthetic fixtures). Replaced before any analysis: the engine now stamps a delivery-instruction receipt (instructChars + instructDigest from the request payload) on every instructed row, and the sidecar fails closed unless the instructed take carries a receipt whose digest matches the manifest's instruction echo and the paired neutral reference carries none. Hypotheses, seeds, and decision rules are unchanged; the sweep restarts from seed 20260810 on the amended tree. RESULTS 2026-08-04 (both arms run and scored exactly as registered; scoring inputs and verdicts retained under outputs/bench-archive/, including dp18-verdicts/): H1 CONFIRMED in both arms — 8-way preset separability replicates on fresh seeds, 4-bit UAR 0.477 and 8-bit UAR 0.375 against the 0.125 computed floor, permutation p=0.001 in each (1000 iterations). H2 CONFIRMED in both arms — every distinct-set cell (neutral, calm, whisper, sad) clears FDR at q<=0.05 in both. H3 REFUTED in both arms — the pre-registered happy-vs-angry 2-way sits at chance (4-bit UAR 0.531 p=0.43; 8-bit UAR 0.583 p=0.24): the instruct channel carries no acoustic happy/angry distinction, upgrading the audit's valence bottleneck from hypothesis to confirmatory result. H4 (descriptive): the 8-bit arm does NOT separate better (0.375 vs 0.477, overlapping per-cell Wilson intervals) — no support for quantization as the adherence bottleneck. Per-cell eligibility under the registered rule (FDR-clear in BOTH arms): angry (0.625/0.333) and fearful (0.750/0.444) meet the acoustic bar; happy fails FDR in both (top confusion angry both times); surprised clears 4-bit only. Interpretation boundary: acoustic separability is not listener recognizability — the DP-12 session heard angry 0/11 and fearful as sad, so the DP-14 hint/distinct split stays until a listening probe on fresh takes says otherwise (maintainer-reviewed either way). Coverage notes, never silent: the 4-bit arm banked 16/18 seeds (20260817 and 20260827 were deterministic dropout-QC casualties at sad.strong-class cells; the 8-bit arm banked 18/18), and the 8-bit arm ran under the same dp18-4bit bench label by scripting slip — arms are separated by per-take modelID, which the collection records. 34 PASS registry records published by the runs are committed with this closure.

items.title: Text-decoration valence channel (audit R5)
items.gate: The audit's decision gate routed here on the branch the session actually landed on (clone-transfer strong, instruct valence weak): measure whether text-side paralinguistic decoration — interjections, punctuation, quoted-style cues appended to the script rather than the instruction — moves valence where the instruct channel does not. Fixed-seed A/B against undecorated text on the same cells, scored by the SER advisory and prosody deltas; product exposure only if the effect is categorical, since it changes the spoken text. PRE-REGISTERED 2026-08-04 before any generation (this commit is the registration). Design: custom/speed, speaker aiden, 12 fresh seeds 20260830..20260841, four cells per seed via vocello generate --delivery: happy.strong and angry.strong instructions crossed with two text arms — PLAIN, the valence-suppressing base sentence 'The morning train slipped quietly out of the station, carrying a handful of sleepy travelers toward the coast.'; and DECORATED, the registered exact variants HAPPY_TEXT='Haha! The morning train slipped quietly out of the station, carrying a handful of sleepy travelers toward the coast. Oh, that is wonderful!' and ANGRY_TEXT='Ugh. The morning train slipped quietly out of the station, carrying a handful of sleepy travelers toward the coast. Enough of this!'. 48 takes, generation strictly before scorers (8 GB rule). Scoring: emotion_advisory per clip (pinned SER, .venv, advisory semantics) and analyze_prosody features into delivery_separability --presets happy,angry per arm (raw-feature records, seed-grouped, --null-iters 1000, confirmatory designation). Hypotheses: H1 per emotion, the decorated arm raises SER target-emotion probability over the plain arm (paired per seed, one-sided Wilcoxon p<0.05 via delivery_statistics); H2 the decorated arm's happy-vs-angry 2-way clears its permutation null (p<0.05) while the plain arm is the internal control expected at chance, mirroring DP-18's refuted H3. Registered interpretation boundary: decoration changes the spoken text, so H2's acoustics include lexical-content effects — H1 (SER) carries the perceptual claim and H2 is supporting; text decoration becomes a product lever only if BOTH hold, and any product exposure (it changes what is spoken) is a separate maintainer-reviewed item. Decision on failure: a null closes the text-decoration route and the valence answer moves to the watch list's external levers (DP-20). RESULTS 2026-08-04 (run exactly as registered; 48/48 takes, zero QC casualties; instruction receipts verified on all instructed rows): H1 NULL for both emotions — decoration did not raise SER target probability (happy meanDiff +0.088, dz 0.21, Wilcoxon p=0.52, win 0.58 [0.32,0.81]; angry meanDiff -0.069, dz -0.27, p=0.27, win 0.33 — directionally negative), and top-1 agreement was unchanged (happy 7/12 to 8/12; angry 2/12 to 1/12). H2 uninterpretable in decoration's favor: the decorated arm cleared its permutation null (2-way UAR 0.792, p=0.018) but so did the plain internal control (0.75, p=0.037), so decoration added ~0.04 UAR over baseline — not the categorical gain the lever needed. ANALYSIS AMENDMENT (pre-H2, recorded): the registered raw feature space (55 features) was refused by the scorer's own power rail at 24 takes; the structural 21-feature harness-axis subset (raw counterparts of the standard delta axes) was substituted identically for both arms before any H2 number was seen. Measurement note: the plain control exceeding chance in RAW-feature space does not contradict DP-18's at-chance verdict in PAIRED-DELTA space — the spaces measure different things (absolute rendering vs instruction-isolated movement). DECISION per the registered rule (both hypotheses required): text decoration FAILS as a valence lever and the route closes; the valence answer moves to the external levers watched by DP-20. Evidence: scratch verdicts retained locally; the numbers above are the record.

items.gate: Close the phase-12 open item: recalibrate the delivery-adherence rule's per-preset expectations from the banked paired neutral-vs-instructed matrix instead of the conservative seeds. RESULTS 2026-08-05 (method fixed before computing; revisions documented openly): 272 unique banked rows (8 presets x .strong x speed/quality x 17-18 seeds, one fixed text) recomputed through delivery_features. Required floors sit at the observed noise decile (a first-draft q25 floor flagged the bottom quartile of genuinely adhering takes by construction and was rejected); supporting floors at |q10| so only clear opposite moves flag (~10% designed tail). fearful's arousal direction was corrected -1 -> +1 from its own .strong instruction text ('trembling panic ... urgent ... fast uneven pacing'); the old seed scored adherence backwards (posRate 0.71 under +1). New semantically-central binds from features the analyzer and Swift measurement keys already carried: whisper voice_breathiness_score required (posRate 0.97, the strongest delivery signature measured to date), whisper voiced-fraction drop required (0.94), sad pitch-variation collapse required (0.94), angry/happy voice_tension_score supporting (0.82/0.76), fearful turning-point quaver supporting (0.68). Genuine adherence misses were deliberately NOT tuned away and keep warning at seed values: surprised pitch rise (posRate 0.62) and fearful fast-pacing (the model gets slower in 74% of takes despite 'urgent, fast'). Gate algorithm v2: expectations may bind optional-analyzer features and a pre-v3 pair skips them into the verdict's unavailableFeatures list instead of failing metrics_incomplete; Swift passthrough comment updated in lockstep. Bank replay under the calibrated profile (digest 133d46bd...): 181 pass / 91 warn versus 128/144 under the seeds, with residual warns concentrated on the two kept genuine misses plus the designed noise tails. Verified: 22/22 delivery-gate unit tests (three rewritten for the calibrated profile, three added for skip/flip/breathiness semantics), adjacent prosody/matrix/calibration suites, and a live check_delivery_instructions.py run holding at exactly the 2 acknowledged findings. items.title: Normal-tier acoustic arm: does the normal tier carry the happy/angry distinction (DP-12 follow-up)
items.gate: PRE-REGISTERED 2026-08-05, before any generation. Motivation: DP-12's blind 2AFC found angry-vs-happy discriminable at 0.75 at the normal tier but at chance at strong (one listener, self-agreement ceiling 0.333 — a lead, not a result), while DP-18's confirmatory H3 showed the instruct channel carries no acoustic happy/angry distinction at the shipped strong copy. The normal tier is currently the only measured channel anywhere in the project carrying a happy/angry difference, and it is exactly the machinery DP-9 proposes to delete. Protocol: mirror DP-18's sweep at the normal-tier instruction copies — fresh seeds (>=18), all 8 presets, speed and quality variants, retained WAVs with instruction receipts, scored with delivery_separability.py in confirmatory designation with computed chance floors, FDR correction, and bootstrap CIs. PRIMARY: the pre-registered angry-vs-happy 2-way probe at normal. SECONDARY: 8-way separability at normal versus the DP-18 strong-tier arms. SIDE PAYOFF either way: the run banks real normal-tier paired rows, replacing DP-21's normal minima (currently strong-tier measurements divided by the unvalidated 1.15 intensity scale) with measured floors. DECISION RULE, registered both ways: (a) if the normal tier separates angry-vs-happy acoustically (2-way probe clears its computed floor after FDR), the product move is per-preset tier selection under DP-8's existing 'ship the measured-better copy' rule — angry/happy ship their normal copy — and DP-9 stays parked; (b) if null, DP-12's 0.75 attributes to single-listener noise, the DP-9 unpark condition ('a dedicated measurement shows the tiers carry no exploitable product difference') is met, and DP-9 unparks and executes. Machine-only: needs models and engine time, no phone, no listening; runs serially on the canonical 8 GB machine. RESULTS 2026-08-05 (run and scored the same evening; 17/18 seeds banked — 20260917 was a deterministic dropout-QC casualty, dropped and recorded per protocol). PRIMARY: the normal-tier angry-vs-happy 2-way probe SEPARATES in the 4-bit/speed arm — UAR 0.765 against the 0.5 floor, permutation p=0.007 (1000 iterations), happy FDR-clear per-cell — replicating DP-12's perceptual 0.75 acoustically and standing in direct contrast to DP-18's strong-tier null (0.531, p=0.43). The 8-bit/quality arm is null at both tiers (0.5 here, 0.583 at strong): the channel is 4-bit-specific, mirroring DP-18's arm ordering. DECISION: branch (b) is off — the tier machinery demonstrably carries an exploitable product difference, so DP-9 stays parked. Branch (a) executes in refined form: the exploratory 4-cell cross-tier probe (with the DP-21 strong bank) shows the blanket 'both presets ship normal' sketch is NOT the measured optimum — angry.strong-vs-happy.normal is the widest pairing (distance 2.424 vs 1.469 shipped strong/strong and 2.127 normal/normal), happy.normal is the probe's only FDR-clear cell (8-way recall 0.471 where happy.strong fails FDR in every DP-18 arm), and angry keeps its stronger identity at strong (0.625 vs 0.353). The shipping candidate is therefore happy-at-normal only, registered as DP-23 (confirmatory + maintainer call), not an autonomous copy change. SECONDARY: normal-tier 8-way UAR 0.419 (speed) / 0.309 (quality) vs 0.125 floor, p=0.001 both — slightly below the strong-tier 0.477/0.375. REGISTERED-DEVIATION NOTE (floors): the promised replacement of DP-21's derived normal minima was NOT executed, deliberately — measured normal-tier q10s are mostly negative (normal effects are weak-to-absent for the hint presets; whisper/sad stay solid at posRate 0.85-1.00), so the single global 1.15 intensity scale is now doubly refuted and a one-scale schema cannot anchor both tiers; floors stay strong-anchored because strong is the shipped tier, and per-tier floors (profile schema v4) fold into DP-23 if normal-tier shipping lands. items.title: macOS/CLI chunked byte-range transfers, default on
items.gate: Root cause established by live probes 2026-08-08: the HF Xet CDN throttles per connection (~20 MB/s burst, 2-6 MB/s sustained, high variance) and every file rode one URLSessionDownloadTask; the 2026-06 iOS chunking revert (39485bc) had misdiagnosed the max(64 MiB, size/6) static-split straggler as a chunking defect. Landed: 64 MiB ranges with a quarter-size tail window, bounded work-queue workers, per-chunk transient retry, active sibling cancellation (no duplicate wire bytes), largest-first dispatch, session-namespaced task keys with an optional per-worker-session strategy, chunk transfer-metrics file attribution keeping wireBytes delivery evidence byte-exact, EWMA skip/resume speed-sample exclusion, per-file verifying status, and the registered QVOICE_DOWNLOAD_ENGINE_PROFILE knob. Tuning-policy controlled comparison (interleaved ABBABA, n=6/arm, fresh isolated pro_custom_speed installs): legacy median 232.6 s vs chunked median 30.0 s, an 87.1% median improvement (~7.3 to ~57 MB/s) with zero retries, zero duplicate bytes, nominal thermal, clean integrity, and run-to-run variance collapsed from ~100 s to ~2 s; per-worker sessions measured within noise of the shared session. Defaults flipped for macOS/CLI in the same arc; post-flip live install verified wireBytes 1,708,583,689 exactly at 57.6 MB/s.
